short: the value types: chat, message, user
is: The leaves of the domain model, one module per noun.
conventions: Domain primitives are newtypes: wrapping is a derived `From`, reads go through a named accessor (`as_i64()`) or `AsRef<str>`, never `Deref`.
A validated newtype parses by hand through `TryFrom<String>` plus a delegating `TryFrom<&str>`.
Enum string tables derive strum's Display, EnumString, IntoStaticStr and VariantArray (snake_case), with the tokens pinned by a literal test.

fs.name: chat/
fs.role: ChatId, ChatKind (and may_open), ChatRef (the untrusted spawn reference), ChatTitle, Chat

fs.name: message/
fs.role: MessageId, MessageText (not blank, at most 4096 UTF-16 units), MessageTextError, Message

notes: A ChatRef never carries an access hash: those are per account and per login session.
